title: srs-context should hold the active collections of knowledge, kept light and navigable by dream time (2026-10-27)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Here's another thing to  link. 
Srs-context should ensure that any agent should know about current active collections of knowledge. 

When we are working on a problem , context should hold the information on what topics we have been working through recently and how to find more. Dream time should manage this list, keeping the semantic hierarchy navigable, ensuring that we keep the top levels light and relevant
